answer: Harberger bond: each identity locks 70 credits, posts its price as its signal, and pays 5% of it per epoch as tax. The floor follows a spiral, up 5 per epoch; no fake parks cheap. A falcon auditor may buy a slot at its posted price; a rented-price ring fails and its fakes lose their bonds. 1,000 fakes at 100 pay 5,000 per epoch, 50,000 in 10 epochs, 70,000 locked: 120,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 5 per epoch, keep their bond.
